gloss: to call back; to recall; to summon back

definitions.gloss: to call back; to summon back
definitions.explanation: To ask or order someone who has left to return.

definitions.gloss: to recall; to bring back (memories, feelings)
definitions.explanation: To cause something from the past to come back to mind or existence.

examples.japanese: {出|で}て{行|い}った{息子|むすこ}を{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: I called back my son who had left.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{海外|かいがい}にいた{社員|しゃいん}を{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: The company recalled employees who were overseas.

examples.japanese: その{曲|きょく}は{青春時代|せいしゅんじだい}の{思|おも}い{出|で}を{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す。
examples.english: That song brings back memories of my youth.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す → {呼|よ}び{戻|もど}さない (negative)
・{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す → {呼|よ}び{戻|もど}して (te-form)
・{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す → {呼|よ}び{戻|もど}した (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {呼|よ}ぶ (to call) + {戻|もど}す (to return/put back)

The combination means to call and make return.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{人|ひと}を{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す - to call someone back
・{記憶|きおく}を{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す - to recall memories
・{意識|いしき}を{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す - to bring back to consciousness
・{本国|ほんごく}に{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す - to recall to one's home country

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{呼|よ}び{返|かえ}す - to call back (similar meaning)
